66' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

66' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
64' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
63' The game is interrupted. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

60' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Xavi Simons (Tottenham) replacing Richarlison.
60' We are about to witness a subsitution. Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) for Archie Gray.
59' 1 - 2 Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the top right corner of the net.
58' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
57' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. Good work from Tottenham as they win a corner.

57' What a chance that is! Mohammed Kudus swings the ball into the box, and Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
56' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
55' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
52' Bernd Leno leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Pedro Porro (Tottenham).
52' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The referee blows his whistle, Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
50' Harry Wilson (Fulham) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
49' The game is interrupted. Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
49' Referee Stuart Attwell sees the trip by Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Fulham in a dangerous position.
47' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) sends a long ball in, but Guglielmo Vicario comfortably gathers the ball.
46' A raking crossfield pass from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' A cross from a corner kick by Tottenham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
45+3' A raking crossfield pass from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession. Tottenham have a corner.
45+2' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' A short pass finds Micky van de Ven (Tottenham). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
43' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
42' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
39' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
39' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
37' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul after Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) hacks down one of his opponents.
34' Kenny Tete (Fulham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball is out of play. Fulham will take a throw-in.
30' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) picks up a caution.
29' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
27' The Fulham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
24' Rough tackle by Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Fulham fail to score from a corner as Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) leaps to collect the ball.
22' A corner kick by Tottenham is thwarted by the well prepared Bernd Leno (Fulham).
21' Fulham are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
17' Archie Gray (Tottenham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for an infringement.
15' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) heads on.

12' Richarlison (Tottenham) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Bernd Leno shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
12' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
11' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the left post!
10' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fulham comes to nothing.

10' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Fulham.
10' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

6' 0 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Harry Wilson (Fulham) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the middle of the goal. Guglielmo Vicario just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:2.
4' 0 - 1 Kenny Tete (Fulham) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Guglielmo Vicario. 0:1.
1' Bernd Leno (Fulham) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The ball has crossed the sideline. Fulham are taking a throw-in.
